units.source_text: 忽然，一阵炒栗子的香气扑鼻而来。

en.t: Suddenly, the aroma of roasted chestnuts wafted into her nose.
She really wanted to taste them...

units.source_text: 阿光已经身心交瘁，心里有了这点欲望，这才把她从梦幻中唤醒过来。

en.t: Ah Guang was already exhausted in body and mind, and only when this small desire arose in her heart did it wake her from her dreamlike daze.
